metadata.gust_source: wind_gust_kt (SSW station_gust_kt, from AWS wind_speed_max_10m) -- used AS-IS, no gust_factor applied
metadata.thunderstorm_occurrence_rule: within 100 km of station AND (probability >= 60% OR gust >= 25 kt)
metadata.storm_motion_note: storm_motion_* is the 850 hPa steering wind (cell advection), NOT a surface gust. storm_motion_direction states the compass bearing the cell is heading AND whether that heading is toward, away from, or passing the station.
metadata.note: One Point feature per grid pixel. thunderstorm_prob_pct / _direction / _distance_km / _occurrence vary per pixel; the fields in station_level_fields are constant across the crop.
